services.name: web
services.command: cd frontend && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && exec npm run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 16900

services.name: api
services.command: bash scripts/preview_bootstrap.sh && python -m pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt && exec python -m uvicorn server.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 16901
